messages:
sara: heads up — local evalharness run dropped a few datasets intermittently when using --config pointing to a YAML file with a trailing comma. repro below, happened on mac and linux.

sara: repro steps:
```bash
# create tmp config with trailing comma
echo -e 'datasets:
  - squad_dev,
  - mnli_dev,
' > /tmp/testcfg.yaml
# run harness
python -m evalharness.runner --config /tmp/testcfg.yaml --workdir /tmp/run123
```

sara: observed output (snippet):
```
INFO:loaded 2 datasets
INFO:skipping dataset mnli_dev (parse error)
ERROR:Failed to load dataset: Trailing comma at line 2
```

sara: expectation: config parsing should either be tolerant (strip trailing commas) or fail fast with a clear exit code 2 and message pointing to file+line. current behavior is noisy and CI flaps. :eyes:

mike_ia: can repro. looks like our yaml loader is strict SafeLoader and some callers were passing strings through json.loads first which swallows errors weirdly.

mike_ia: quick hack: replace json.loads with yaml.safe_load everywhere in runner.parse_config and add a validate_config(schema) call. will open a PR.

jonathan: fyi this also affected the CI job 'evalharness-local-check' — it marked as passed sometimes because the runner returned 0 after skipping datasets. we should fail the run if any requested dataset failed to load.

ci-bot: workflow run https://ci.internal.redwood/gh/redwood/inference/actions/72 failed — evalharness-local-check exited 0 (flaky), see logs: /artifacts/72/log.txt

tess: small UX ask: for local runs, could we get an explicit summary at the end like:
```
SUMMARY:
  requested: 2 datasets
  loaded: 1
  failed: 1 (mnli_dev)
  exit: 2 (config error)
```

tess: that would make it obvious in terminal and in CI logs.

mike_ia: agree. will add summary + nonzero exit when any dataset errors. also adding unit test around trailing commas and a small e2e that runs against a tmp config in CI.

sara: also noticed a secondary quirk: quantization benchmark runner ignores metric mapping in the config if --quant flag supplied. caused a silent metric name mismatch in the dashboard. file: evalharness/benchmarks/quant_runner.py line ~120.

mike_ia: thanks — adding that to the PR. might be a namespace collision between metrics_map and default_metrics_map.

jonathan: can we also make the CLI validator command `evalharness validate --config` return a machine-readable JSON output when `--json` is passed? will help our dashboard pipeline parse failures.

mike_ia: yep. returning `{"valid": false, "errors": [...]}` is trivial. will include.

sara: thanks — please tag me on the PR. leaving a reminder to update docs/devex/local-run.md with the new exit codes and example outputs.

ci-bot: PR #481 opened by mike_ia: "cli: tolerant config parsing + better exit codes for dataset load failures" — https://git.internal.redwood/pr/481 (runs tests)

tess: quick note for product: add a lint rule for our example configs in docs repo to prevent trailing commas in examples. tiny but reduces flakiness for folks copying examples. :+1:

sara: great. assigning follow-ups:
- mike_ia: PR + tests + summary output + JSON validator (ETA: tomorrow)
- jonathan: update CI job to fail on exit code != 0 (ETA: this week)
- tess: doc lint rule (ETA: next sprint)

sara: thanks all — this explains a bunch of the intermittent CI reds I've been triaging.
